method: Read-only audit, 2026-10-06. Wikidata v3 store (amni.compute.wikifact) scanned per item: all facts of the top question entities matched against gold, inverse facts of the gold entity, plus targeted QID/PID probes (qualifiers checked for counts/earliest). ConceptNet 5.7 edges (cognition.cne both directions) and WordNet glosses/lemmas/meronyms (nltk) for question terms and gold terms. Passages: rknow wiki_v2 index search (k=60) + linked pages + hand-picked title pages (adam_t_client._pages), sentence-level match of gold (know) or mechanism keywords (explain), then manual reading of the best sentence. Compute: amni.math.answer.solve_math on the raw question and on reformulations. classes = reachable with a stored fact/text that states the gold; weak_classes = related but indirect (loose property, partial join, figurative text, cause-only fact, needs an external fact or unsupported computation). primary = first strong class in order wd_entity, wd_value, concepts, passages, compute; primary_lenient also admits weak classes. Inverse WD facts (answer is the subject, e.g. symbol/short-name/nickname/atomic-number lookups) and WD aliases count as wd_value; superlatives/counts that need aggregation over several entities are not counted as WD-reachable. wd_subject_only = a WD entity for the question topic exists but no strong WD fact gives the gold (explain items: topic entity exists, no mechanism fact). v3_resolver_answer = W.ask(q) on the raw question; v3_accepted = W.answer(q) (conf >= AMNI_WIKIFACT_THR, temporal gate).
